name: Bouncy Bopper
notes: A5 (#102, #118). Padded staff with a long reach. From Yellow belt (rooms with minBeltTier 2). Base 66 Health and 11 power (R-BAL-12 option B, Manager: was 110/16, which was out of the #188 mid band at every belt once ENEMY_TRAINING_SCALE applies). Disarmed (Perfect Counter with Disarm), it drops the staff and its next attack is a weak push: same wind-up and warning, power 8. Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
